# Quiver Car Rental

> Quiver Car Rental is a self-drive car rental company based in Swakopmund, Namibia. It rents one vehicle only: the Toyota Fortuner 4x4 (7-seat SUV, 2.4L turbo diesel, automatic), with unlimited kilometres.

## Key facts
- Location: Swakopmund, Erongo Region, Namibia. Time zone: Central Africa Time (UTC+2).
- Vehicle: Toyota Fortuner 4x4, 7 seats, 2.4L turbo diesel, automatic transmission. It is the only vehicle rented.
- Kilometres: unlimited, with no per-kilometre charge.
- Rental period: charged per 24-hour period from collection (not calendar days). Minimum 3 days, no maximum.
- Daily rate depends on pickup location: Swakopmund N$1,850; Hosea Kutako International Airport (Windhoek) N$1,900; Walvis Bay International Airport N$2,050. Currency: Namibian dollars (NAD).
- Refundable deposit: N$3,500, returned in full if there is no damage to the vehicle.
- Handover points: Swakopmund (base), Hosea Kutako International Airport, Walvis Bay International Airport. No delivery to private addresses or hotels.
- Requirements: valid ID or passport and a driver's licence. Passenger liability insurance is carried on every vehicle.
- Languages: the website and communication are in English; a German-language overview page is available at /de.
- Booking: online at https://quivercarrental.com/booking, or by WhatsApp or email. Bookings from overseas are handled in English.
- Contact: +264 81 808 9213 (WhatsApp), quivercar@gmail.com
- Search terms: car rental Swakopmund, car hire Swakopmund, 4x4 rental Namibia, Toyota Fortuner hire Namibia, Autovermietung Swakopmund.
